title: Karbala Dikha To
body:
ay mere maula hussain
ay mere aaqa hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere maula ay mere aaqa
marne se pehle karbala dikha de
<<DIVIDER>>
allahum arzukhna shafatal hussain
allahum arzukhna ziaratal hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
mai mar na jaaun tumse mile bin
ye soch kar mai rota hoo har din
mas kar ke tere rauze se maula
apna kafan sab laate hai lekin
tera kafan mai laaunga mujhko
ay bekafan koi raasta dikha de
karbala dikha de
allahum marzukhna...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghurbat ka aalam sab se chupa kar
karbobala seene mein basa kar
shauk e ziyarat mein jee raha hoo
mai bhi namak se rotiyan kha kar
muflis hoo kaise rauze pe aaun
maula tu koi maujiza dikha de
karbala dikha de
allahum marzukhna...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaair banoo mai uske haram ka
sab par hai saaya jis ke alam ka
tum to kareem e karbobala ho
mai muntazir hoo tere karam ka
ab bhi jahan hai mashk e sakina
mujhko wo rauza e bawafa dikha de
karbala dikha de
allahum marzukhna...
<<DIVIDER>>
us bawafa ka chehra jahan par
zakhmi huwa tha ghode se gir kar
baazu kahin thay paon kahin thay
kis tarha dekha tumne wo manzar
ghazi jahan par bikhra huwa tha
haye wo nehr e alqama dikha de
karbala dikha de
allahum marzukhna...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ko qasam hai us naujawan ki
jis ke jigar mein tooti sina thi
matam karun mai jaa kar wahan par
akbar ke baba hasrat hai meri
khaynchi jahan par seene se barchi
aankhon ko meri wo jagah dikha de
karbala dikha de
allahum marzukhna...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein jahan tum thak kar gire thay
uthna tha mushkil zakhmi thay itne
phir us muqaam e mehdi se chal kar
tum qatl gaah tak aaye thay kaise
kohniyo ke bal chalna hai mujhko
wo raah e sidratul muntaha dikha de
karbala dikha de
allahum marzukhna...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aa rahi hai karbobala ki
sunlo sada zeeshan o raza ki
bulwa lo hum ko is arbaeen par
hai ye tamanna ahle aza ki
paidal najaf se aana hai chal ke
jannat ka mujhko tu raasta dikha de
karbala dikha de
allahum marzukhna...
author: Zeeshan Abidi
